method.renderer: Unreal Engine 5.8 offscreen Metal gameplay viewport
method.comparison_normalization: letterbox removed and accepted frame resized to the historical 1280x720 fixed-camera frame

accepted_visual_terrain_contract.visual_tile_shadow_policy: coarse source self-shadow suppressed on non-colliding visual tiles only

normalized_frame_metrics.interpretation: The accepted frame removes the false dark comb and coarse self-shadow field; the brighter, flatter canyon remains a review compromise rather than final lighting.

rejected_experiments: A 12 m reconstruction bracket exaggerated large shadow teeth and was reverted.
Two high-density centerline bank-ribbon prototypes folded across tight bends and were removed from both source and the regenerated map.
Lighting alone moved or exposed the 30 m source-facet pattern; it did not reliably remove it.
Larger unsupported displacement was rejected because it would fabricate unsupported canyon geometry.
visual_findings: The default runnable capture no longer shows the dominant diagonal or vertical terrain self-shadow comb.
Central-difference normals remove the previous triangle-diagonal normal bias, and near-Nyquist authored relief has been slowed and reduced.
The waterline, collision Landscape, centerline, water surface, hazards, raft forces, and solver state are unchanged.
The canyon remains rounded, bright, sparsely vegetated at gameplay distance, and far below photoreal production quality.
external_gates_remaining: guide and geospatial approval of the full-reach centerline and vertical and horizontal datums
